Country and region dropdown data

Source: https://github.com/country-regions/country-region-data
Version: 4.1.0
Revision: e65e124da5e846a833eba68e228b6d50aad42817
Data: https://github.com/country-regions/country-region-data/blob/e65e124da5e846a833eba68e228b6d50aad42817/data.json

public/locations.js contains a compact, alphabetically sorted copy of the
country names, country short codes, region names, and region short codes.
The data is bundled locally; the Settings page makes no external requests.
